item.coloph: dus mtha'i sprang btsun bdag gis kyang / sngags sems mtshan nyid gting dpag btag (brtag) dka' bas/ the tshom blo yi spros pa rab chad nas/ rgyud lung man ngag bye ba sa ya las/ gsang sngags yang bcud man ngag gsang ba 'di/ rgyud 'grel man ngag lung dang bcas pa rnams/ dam tshig ldan pa'i bu ni nyin skar tsam mo/ gsang thub la sogs rab du dgos/ de ltar gsang ba'i rgyud 'grel man ngag 'di/ phyi rab skal ldan rnams kyi don du bkod/ dge ba 'di kyang gzhan phan dngos grub shog/
